title: How to Store Christmas Cookies: Which Kinds Stay Fresh, Which Freeze and How Long Each Lasts
excerpt: Cool them completely, keep crisp and soft cookies apart, layer frosted ones with parchment and freeze anything baked early: how to store every kind of Christmas cookie so it still tastes fresh on the day.
